text:
emma: ArgonCompute asked for a joint perf/W spotlight for the marketplace tile. They want a reproducible artifact bundle + a short co-announcement. Can we scope acceptance criteria and a publishable package?

ryan: Proposed minimal acceptance criteria:
- sustained tokens/s >= 11,200 per rack (steady-state)
- perf/W >= 13 tokens/s/W (mean across 3 runs)
- p99 <= 260ms at 512 context
These are a bit aggressive but align with marketing ask. Thoughts?

ada: Aggressive but doable if kernel layout+prefetch patch lands. Also require we standardize measurement: wall watts from PDU, 300s steady window after warmup, report mean/std across runs.

argon-eng: We can provision an engineer for the cross-org test. We'll also share rack cooling spec and hero image. One ask: please include cooling and PDU wiring in the public artifact so customers understand measurement context.

ryan: Plan: ada will push kernel PR today (layout-prefetch-3), infra runs 3 sweeps on Rack-C tomorrow, then we assemble CSV + charts + config. If metrics meet thresholds we tag artifacts for marketplace tile.

ada: I'll open the PR and add a README describing the micro-optimizations. Note: it's small changes (tensor stride, L2 prefetch hints) — want to be transparent but not overly technical in the tile.

ada: ```
# smoke command (repro)
./bench_runner --model=redwood-10b --seq=512 --warmup=180 --steady=300 \
  --runs=3 --collect=tokens_per_s,p99_latency,pdu_watts --kernel=layout-prefetch-3 \
  --out=artifacts/argon-3run.csv
```

ryan: Ops will run bench_runner with PDU scraper. We'll also capture GPU power counters and wall watts for cross-check.

argon-eng: We'll provide PDU IDs and confirm our PDUs report wall watts. Note our rack uses redundant PDUs; please sum both legs and report total wall watts.

emma: Marketing requests the following artifact package for tile signoff: raw CSVs, mean/std table, kernel commit hash, config.yaml, 16:9 image, and a short 3-bullet "how we tested" snippet. Tile must contain conservative verified numbers only. Blog/press can explain kernel uplift and include config details.

ops-bot: Created ticket LEGAL-888 for co-announcement review. ETA 48h. Calendar invite sent for Thurs 10am PT cross-org test.

ryan: Action items:
- ada: open kernel PR + include README (due: today EOD)
- ops: run 3x sweeps on Rack-C and post CSVs (due: tomorrow 3pm PT)
- argon-eng: share rack spec + hero image (due: tomorrow EOD)
- emma: hold draft tile copy until legal clears (in progress)

emma: If runs miss the perf/W target but show consistent uplift vs baseline, we can consider a conditional blog note about upcoming kernel availability. Marketplace tile remains strict.

argon-eng: We'll be on the Thursday call. Also happy to co-sign the artifact package once we verify CSVs.

ada: Running local quick sweep now; will paste a preview of numbers soon. If the uplift matches our internal estimate (~9% perf/W) we should be in range.

ryan: Thanks all. Keep this thread for artifacts and final numbers. Ping here if anything shifts. :white_check_mark:
